seo.description: We seek out and find sales markets, partners and investment opportunities for you in Belarus and the EAEU.

titleLines: to the markets of Belarus, Russia and the EAEU
hero.lead: We seek out and find sales markets, partners and investment opportunities for you in Belarus and the EAEU.

cards.title: Investing in Belarus — a way into the EAEU
cards.text: We help Italian companies invest in Belarus and use it as a base to enter the Eurasian Economic Union market (over 180 million people).
items: Assess the prospects and risks of each project.
Arrange direct contact with key stakeholders.

cards.title: Retail in Belarus and Russia
cards.text: We bring Italian products into retail networks in both countries. We handle buyer searches, negotiations, logistics and certification — from the first contact to shipment.
items: Find wholesale customers and retail chains.

about.title: Who we are
paragraphs: VIKUB is an international consulting hub.
We are husband and wife, an Italian and a Belarusian. We live and work in both countries. We know the business cultures, legislation and markets of Italy, Belarus and the EAEU from the inside.
We are official representatives of NAIP in Italy.

seminar.title: Join our online seminar on {date}
seminar.text: A free online seminar for Italian manufacturers: actual needs of Belarusian businesses, the investment climate, sanctions and tax issues, logistics and certification.

contact.title: Ready to discuss your project?
contact.text: Tell us about your idea. We will assess its prospects and tell you whether we can help. If not, we will say so honestly.
